inputs.question: On the electrical design plan (Sheet 21), identify all locations of transformers (pad-mounted electrical equipment) and their exact positions. Then cross-reference these locations with the landscape plan (Sheet 31) to determine which trees or plantings are within 10 lateral feet of any transformer location. List the distances from transformers to nearby trees.
inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment, or between equipment access door and drivable surface
inputs.regionHint: Focus on the transformer pad locations shown on the electrical design plan and measure distances to nearby building areas and property boundaries where trees might be planted
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent question explicitly asks to 'determine which trees or plantings are within 10 lateral feet of any transformer location' and to 'list the distances from transformers to nearby trees'—this is a direct clearance/distance measurement task between two physical features (transformers and trees), matching the core compliance requirement.
